slides.texte_overlay:
how to actually lock in
and become the best version of yourself

1. decide what 'better' means for you

not for tiktok. write three things you want to be true by june.

2. feed your brain, not just your feed

this morning i learned that cleopatra lived closer to the moon landing than to the building of the great pyramid.
i haven't stopped thinking about it.
slides.texte_sophia:
2. feed your brain, not just your feed

this morning, the Sophia app taught me that cleopatra lived closer to the moon landing than to the building of the great pyramid.
i haven't stopped thinking about it.

slides.texte_overlay:
3. keep promises to yourself, even tiny ones

say you'll read ten pages, read ten pages.
that's how you start trusting yourself.

4. do the hard thing first

the rest of the day feels lighter
when the worst part is behind you.

5. stop announcing, start doing

tell people after.
it's a lot more fun.
which one are you starting today?
